title: Visual response harness profile
description: One file per harness in harnesses/<id>.json. Adding a harness needs a profile and, when it has a bridge, an adapter script; no renderer rebuild.

detect.description: Environment markers for --harness auto. All of `env` must match ("*" means set to anything); any one of `anyEnv` must be set.

adapter.description: Adapter script next to the profile that defines window.visualResponseHost, or null for the renderer's built-in static host.

standaloneHarness.description: Profile to use instead when placement chooses standalone.

inlineHarness.description: Profile to use instead when placement chooses inline.

standaloneFallback.description: Profile to use when standaloneHarness can't load the configured renderer URL (its csp.scriptHosts would block it).

artifactCapabilities.description: Capabilities an artifact page must declare when published.

hostPalette.description: For appearance "host": theme palette role → host CSS variable name, read at runtime.
